theme: An open day, mid-charter — the clocks are all on travel bookings.
greeting: Your calendar is clear and the girls are with Jen, but you're mid-charter with the Adriatic between you and a stack of unbooked logistics. Two clocks are actually ticking today: the Cavtat leg and a Christmas rental.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: Due today in Todoist. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out; book it refundable now and fix the dates later once the trip firms up.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat landing before you sail out of range
needsAttention.detail: The charter ends Sept 19 at Komolac and the Remisens hotel's free cancellation ends tomorrow night; the noon transfer, an early bag hold, and a 5:15 AM checkout for the Sept 20 flight all still need arranging from dry land.

needsAttention.title: St Pete Airbnb — switch or let it charge
needsAttention.detail: The $2,331 St Pete booking charges Sept 18, so a better option can still be swapped in until then. The check task is due tomorrow.

flagged.title: Governance intro through Valoris
flagged.detail: Mike Lubrano looped you and Chie Mitsui into a Mercer/Marsh pension-advisory introduction; you're only cc, so nothing's owed from you yet.

flagged.title: Ethics & Boards connection request
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invite from the Ethics & Boards CEO — worth accepting to keep the governance network warm.

flagged.title: Philip wants to reconnect before he sails
flagged.detail: A Maine friend writing before he leaves Saturday for a two-week Med cruise; a short reply would keep the thread alive.

inbox.noise: Everything else is newsletters and retail — NYT Cooking, Maine seafood, chocolate, book clubs, and the usual promos.

recipe.title: Pork chops with roasted beets & escarole salad
recipe.why: An autumn dish that leans on what the harvest season brings in.

tasks.title: Book the Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV outright
Buy Disney tickets for the Sept 26–27 weekend
Finish the four kids' passport packet

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — the whole day is open water.
No meetings to work around; the leverage today is in the travel bookings, not the inbox.
The girls are with Jen tonight, so it's a quiet one at anchor.
